# `set_camera_idx`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Select which camera from the camera list is the guide camera.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x73130 (64-bit build) |

Refused with 312 while the camera is connected. Otherwise logs and selects the camera through the equipment dialog logic. The parameter is a bare integer or the first element of an array. The wrong-shape error is labelled expected object param (107) although an integer is expected; this is recorded as in the source. Index bounds are delegated to the selection list and are unresolved. Via the imager command port (4700) the request reaches this handler only as a forwarded unknown method; see the control service for the relay.

Side effects: Changes the selected camera.

| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_camera_idx"`. [READ] |
| `params` | integer\|array | yes | - | Camera list index: a bare integer or an array whose first element is the integer. No handler bound. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | Parameter is not of the accepted shape or type (label says object although an integer is expected) | `expected object param` |
| 312 | The camera is currently connected | `cannot select if equipment are connected` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request is not an object, is an empty object, or has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: no method of type string (a non-string method counts as missing) | `invalid request` |
| 101 | Dispatcher: text fails to parse | `invalid JSON request: <reason> on line <n> ...` |
| 103 | Dispatcher: unregistered method | `method not found` |
